name: Ten Minutes With a Hero
source:
Once upon a time, there was a blond-haired, blue-eyed, very handsome (arguably cute) hero who defeated the Demon King. Unfortunately for you, you're a witch, meaning when the Demon Realm's economy and government fall apart, your life kinda does too. Fortunately, some of your colleagues have captured the hero and have deemed it YOUR job to try to interrogate him. So what if he's the strongest man alive? You'll be just fine. Probably.

[from [url=https://723snek.itch.io/ten-minutes-with-a-hero]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，有一个金发碧眼、非常英俊（可以说是可爱）的英雄，他打败了魔王。对你来说不幸的是，你是一个女巫，这意味着当魔界的经济和政府崩溃时，你的生活也会崩溃。幸运的是，你的一些同事已经抓住了这位英雄，并认为你的工作就是试图审问他。如果他是现存最强的人又如何？你会没事的。大概。

[来自[url=https://723snek.itch.io/ten-minutes-with-a-hero]itch.io[/url]]
